correctness.rationale: Two-spoke edge pairs realize every two-element outer-vertex resolving neighborhood. All remaining resolving neighborhoods contain at least two outer vertices, so the original edge-resolving LP is exactly the complete pair-cover system on outer vertices plus a free nonnegative center coordinate. Coordinatewise minimality forces the center to zero and gives either the uniform half-vector or one distinguished low coordinate with all other outer coordinates equal to its complement. Independent distance-based LP checks through eight triangles confirm the reduction and unique optimum.
